_: Node contract of this element (step 417): what the node needs to install, run and manage it. Read by the node core only; never served to the outside. The public description is OWN-SERVICE-PROPS/.

port.note: A wish, not a decision. The node assigns the actual port from the block 24680-25679. Ask the node, never remember.

env.note: Next reads .env.local by its own convention.

health.note: The former door of the sign-in service (v1.3.23): it runs the service's own logic and needs neither a session nor a key; /api/session answers 401 without a session. /api/health of the template answers too.

runtime.startNote: The standalone server reads PORT and HOSTNAME from the environment. The installer finds server.js under .next/standalone and copies .next/static next to it.
runtime.distDirNote: The node builds into a neighbour folder named by this variable while the old build serves, then switches: no downtime. A replacement that does not declare it is stopped for the build.

settings.note: 549-5: the template door of the own DESIGN-CONFIG, the same contract as the former door (key, GET and PATCH). The design element signals /api/settings/changed.

contract: Takes its port from the environment; never remembers a number.
Answers GET /api/auth/methods and GET /api/health with 200 without a session.
IS the node's sign-in service: the only element that hands out entry. Two sign-ins on a node are no sign-in.
Keeps accounts in its own SQLite file (DATABASE_URL) — the one named exception to «stored data only through the data element»: the sign-in service must work before any other element.
Public pages stay static: no force-dynamic, no cookies() or headers() in a layout or a page; the form pages and the signed-in card are its own root pages.
Reads its own name from this passport at start (lib/own-id.ts); no name of the element is written in its code.

languages.note: The sign-in forms speak 82 languages (owner 2026-09-20: reducing this set is forbidden). The public home page speaks this site's own set (NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES, en and ru).

storage.file: DATABASE_URL (the node writes <node>/data/services/auth/auth.db); guest-limits.json next to it
